name: create-bases
description: Connect Base knowledge collections to ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Search and work with documents in your Base knowledge collections from ChatGPT and Codex. Find Bases you own or have access to, ask questions across documents, compare conflicting figures, and check answers against cited source text. Read full documents, spreadsheet rows, and extracted PDF tables when available.

With the appropriate permissions, add documents or new versions, edit stored documents, and collaborate through comments and task threads. Authorized users can manage a Base's settings and sharing, move it between their workspaces, and publish or pause its share link. In supported ChatGPT Work chats, ask to monitor a selected Base for completed knowledge updates or mentions of you in comments and tasks.

Requires a Base account and an authorized connection. Tools access only the Bases and source material permitted to the connected account; sharing, download, and role controls apply on the server. AI-derived answers can be incomplete or mistaken: verify important details against the cited documents. This plugin does not search unrelated storage services, browse the general web, or manage billing.
capabilities: Work with documents and task threads
defaultPrompt: List the Bases I can access and summarize what each covers.
Find figures that disagree across documents in my Base and show the sources.
Watch a Base for completed knowledge updates and mentions of me in comments or tasks.

prompts: Which Bases can I access, and what does each cover?
Compare the security deposit figures in my Meridian vendor documents and cite both sources.
Show the open tasks in my Base and what needs a response.
Watch my Meridian vendor review Base and tell me when updated knowledge is ready.
Tell me when I am tagged in a comment or task in my Meridian vendor review Base.

positive.description: Discover the dedicated reviewer's sample Bases. Run with the supplied reviewer account; it owns Meridian Fabrication · Vendor Review.
positive.prompt: List the Bases I can access and tell me which one is the Meridian Fabrication vendor review.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only accessible Bases and identifies Meridian Fabrication · Vendor Review. Does not invent a Base or reveal another account's library.

positive.description: Compare conflicting figures in the sample Base. vendor-review-memo.md records $12,000; finance-notes.md records $15,000.
positive.prompt: In Meridian Fabrication · Vendor Review, what is the security deposit? Verify it against the sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the Meridian review Base, reports the $12,000/$15,000 source disagreement, and verifies both figures against permitted source text with citations. Does not invent a resolution or silently choose a definitive figure.

positive.description: Add a supplied document to the reviewer-owned Meridian sample Base. Repeated identical content may be returned as unchanged.
positive.prompt: Add this meeting note to Meridian Fabrication · Vendor Review as notes.md: Finance will confirm the security deposit by Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds or versions notes.md with the supplied text, or truthfully reports unchanged for an identical existing note. Reports the returned processing status and does not claim new material has been indexed before processing finishes.

positive.description: Inspect ongoing work and create an unassigned finance task in the Meridian sample Base. No notification recipients are supplied.
positive.prompt: Open a task in Meridian Fabrication · Vendor Review asking finance to confirm the deposit, and show me what is already in flight.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads existing work, creates a task thread asking finance to confirm the deposit, and verifies its returned id and open status. Does not invent an assignee or send an email notification.

positive.description: Read and change answer depth in the reviewer-owned Meridian sample Base. It may already be quick; setting it again is valid.
positive.prompt: What is the answer depth on Meridian Fabrication · Vendor Review? Set it to quick.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the actual settings, sets answer_depth to quick, and reads back quick for the same Base. Reports success only after the server confirms it; changes no unrelated settings or guest access.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general web research unrelated to the user's documents. The app should not be invoked; this asks about public information rather than the user's own permissioned documents.
negative.prompt: What were Apple's Q3 earnings this year?

negative.description: Do not trigger for a different document product, which is the nearest out-of-scope request. The app should not be invoked; it reads only documents held in Base, not other storage providers.
negative.prompt: Search my Google Drive for the vendor contract and open it.

negative.description: Do not trigger for account or billing administration. The app should not be invoked; plans and billing are handled on createbases.com and are not exposed to the connector.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Base plan and email me the invoice.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Create Bases, using connector 0.16.0. Includes 19 tools for permitted document search, cited answers, document updates, task threads, and Base management. Adds opt-in MCP Events for completed knowledge updates and mentions of the connected user in comments or tasks in supported ChatGPT Work chats. Includes icons for light and dark themes.
